title: CFPB Updates Consumer Complaint Portal Intake Architecture
discussion_signal: The post interprets CFPB complaint-portal changes as intake and routing changes rather than guaranteed resolution: more disclosures, stronger identity requirements, direct-dispute sequencing, and clearer limits on what the portal promises. It is useful for separating complaint submission from legal remedy and resolution, although it is an outside interpretation of the portal changes.
linked_research_question: Do changes that improve complaint authenticity and routing also improve consumer correction and remedy, or do they mainly shift effort back to the person filing?
limits: The post does not measure consumer outcomes after intake changes
Portal architecture is not the same as enforcement or compensation
The canonical URL is an indexed discussion relay and may omit later comments or updates
